'''Kallad's Dream Vacation Hostel''' was a hotel on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as of [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. The [[Horn family]] booked a suite there. The rental quarters there were lightly constructed, for the ease of remodeling. It was here that [[Valin Horn]] came down with [[Force psychosis]].
